description: Execute any operation from the catalogue. Path parameters are taken from `params` by name; remaining `params` entries become query parameters. Nested objects are encoded in sevDesk's bracket syntax (a[b]=c). Mutating operations are refused when the server runs with SEVDESK_READ_ONLY=true, and are only described (not sent) when SEVDESK_DRY_RUN=true or `dryRun` is passed. ⚠️ This tool can change data in sevDesk.

body.description: JSON request body, for POST/PUT operations.

dryRun.description: Describe the request that would be sent instead of sending it.

params.description: Path and query parameters, keyed by parameter name.

name: sevdesk_call
title: Call any sevDesk API operation
